presentation_chrome: The 1008x720 frame is a presentation canvas: a light #f9f9f9 ground with a Hook / Demo / End Result / CTA segmented chip bar and a red playhead along the bottom. The film is the black 16:9 inner panel at x 61-947, y 62-558 (886x496 px, measured on frame-1.50 / frame-8.50 with the 10% grid). Every citation, fill and type size in this spec refers to that panel; fills are divided by 496, its shorter side. The chip labels are an annotation track that matches the film's acts (the playhead enters Demo at ~7.4 s, End Result at ~15.4 s, CTA at ~19.0 s); the chrome is not replicated.
use_when: A 26 s product-demo spot on a flat black bed: chat request -> real editor UI -> one glide into an agent panel -> typed prompt -> streamed reply and linear count-up -> changes list -> chat payoff -> two CTA lines word by word -> logo; joined almost entirely by one-frame cuts (four plain, four reframes on the same surface, two leftward throws) with lateral slide exits/entrances; use it for a fixed-lens, cut-driven demo with typed prompts and text payoffs.

pacing.seams_on_onsets: 2 of 11 cut/throw seams within 60 ms of an onset (5.792 at +58 ms, 15.417 at -17 ms) against a chance level of ~3.5 of 11 at 2.68 onsets/s - the film is not cut to the beat; four more are near misses at +73..+95 ms (10.958, 12.042, 13.125, 19.167). Two settles land on hits: the glide settles at 9.667 (+13 ms) and the 'Grow' throw settles at 17.625 (-25 ms). The bed's accented hits repeat every ~1.09 s (8.85, 9.94, 11.04 ... 21.96); only 15.4 has a cut on it.
pacing.typing_cadence: one typing beat, ~22 chars/s average in bursts: an initial ~10-char burst within 2 frames of the click (8.917-8.958), then ~1 char per frame (24 chars/s) with single-frame pauses to 9.833; a 0.17 s pause; '@homepag' at ~48 chars/s (10.0-10.167); picker resolves to a chip at 10.292; a 0.2 s pause; 'acros' at ~12 chars/s (10.5-10.917). Caret visible throughout.
pacing.stagger_spacing: Changes rows 0.125 s apart (3 frames); CTA words 0.375 s (Grow -> faster), 0.125 s (With -> the brand), 0.333 s (the brand -> Agents); streamed reply words 0.04-0.08 s; hook roll words 0.10 -> 0.37 s lengthening

camera_note: The lens travels once: a 0.58 s glide into the agent panel (9.083 -> 9.667, x2.3, small-big-small steps, no blur). Every other framing change is a one-frame join - four hard cuts, four reframe cuts on the surface already on screen (x2.05 into the chat, x2.2 and then a scrolled crop on the agent panel, one pull to the summary) and two leftward throws between the CTA cards. What moves instead is content (word roll, typing, streamed words, count-up, list scroll, pulsing dots, shimmer) and object slides: a content block leaves left before three cuts (7.3, 17.25, 19.17) and lands from the right after four (2.125, 13.125, 17.375, 19.333).
